## Explore our range of fixed income strategies

We offer diverse fixed income strategies to help meet our clients’ needs. Our approach is to continuously adapt to changing market conditions and search for new alpha sources globally. The platform’s investment philosophy is backed by leading technology, risk management, and deep market insights.

Set a target savings rate. Aim to save 10-15% of your income if possible. Start with whatever you can manage, even if it’s just 3-5%, and increase it as your income grows. Automate your contributions so saving happens without you thinking about it.
   Invest in high-growth assets. You can afford to be aggressive with stocks and stock-focused mutual funds. Market downturns won’t derail your long-term plans because you have many years to recover and benefit from rebounds. [...] Aggressive portfolio (85% stocks, 10% bonds, 5% cash): You’re focused on maximum growth and can handle volatility. Your portfolio leans heavily into stocks, accepting short-term market swings for long-term gains. This works if you have a long-time horizon and strong risk tolerance.
